messages:
marie: quick favor — can someone run a kernel-merge benchmark sweep across the new kernel variants?
seeing a p99 jump on main for long-seq (8k+) workloads after PR #3481. need numbers for gpu types + kv-cache on/off. tl;dr command below.

marie: ```bash
./bench_run.py --variants kernel-merge-a,kernel-merge-b,kernel-merge-c \
  --model gpt2xl --seq 8192 --iters 50 --cache {on,off} \
  --log /tmp/bench_pr3481.json
```

aj: on it, queued on dev-gpu-2 :hourglass_flowing_sand: I'll run fp16 + q8_0. want q4 as well?

marie: q4 not required for the first pass. fp16 + q8_0 is enough. short smoke first then full. thx :thumbsup:

dev-bot: Benchmark job started — job_id=6789, node=dev-gpu-2, args="--iters 5 smoke"

sam: I can collect perf traces + flamegraphs after the full run. ping me when the full iters finish and I'll triage p99 sources.

ops-lead: note — dev-gpu-2 has a scheduled nightly drain at 23:00 UTC. if your full run >30m it might get evicted. consider dev-gpu-4 for long runs.

lee: small tip: for kernel-merge experiments also capture CUDA kernel names (nvprof/nvtx) and set RUNTIME_PROF=1 to get timeline. also confirm cuda/cuDNN stack: cu11 vs cu12 can change kernel selection.

aj: acknowledged. running smoke (5 iters) now: `./bench_run.py --variants kernel-merge-a,kernel-merge-b --iters 5 --seq 8192 --model gpt2xl`

marie: perfect. once you have numbers drop them into the PR comment and link the perf dashboard: https://dash/perf/PR-3481 

aj: smoke done, no obvious regressions. kicking off full run on dev-gpu-4 with fp16 + q8_0. ETA ~40m.

sam: i'll standby to pull traces after job_id=6790 completes. @aj please include the raw out json and the sample log.

marie: awesome — if we see >10% p99 regression we'll revert the kernel merge and open a follow-up to isolate op-level regressions. thanks team.
